newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Progen soars on cancer drug results.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Progen soars on cancer drug results.

text.p: The shares of biotechnology company Progen Industries Ltd rose sharply on Thursday after the company said it had received encouraging results from tests of its anti-cancer compound PI-88.
At 11.15 a.m. (0015 GMT), Progen shares were 14 cents or 18.9 percent higher at 88 cents on turnover of 284,905 shares.

Earlier on Thursday, Progen said the PI-88 compound significantly inhibited the growth rate of human colon cancer in mice which had been transplanted with primary human tumours. No toxic side effects had been observed.

Progen, which was floated in 1995, has spent about A$1 million a year to fund research into developing an anti-cancer compound at the John Curtin School of Medical Research at the Australian National University in Canberra.
